PROC:cat: read and display file contents, often used for file inspection and data collection
PROC:head: display first lines of a file, used for quick file preview or partial read

PROC:more: paginated file viewer, basic file reading

PROC:rsync: remote file synchronization, efficient file transfer between hosts

PROC:openssl: SSL TLS toolkit and crypto library, encryption and certificate operations
PROC:xxd: hexadecimal dump of binary files, binary data inspection

PROC:nohup: run command immune to hangups, persistent background execution

PROC:pkill: kill processes by name, batch process termination
PROC:systemd-executor: systemd service executor, system service process spawning
PROC:cp: copy files and directories, file duplication including to tmp or dev shm
PROC:mv: move or rename files, file relocation
PROC:rm: remove files or directories, deletion and cleanup including evidence removal
PROC:mkdir: create directories, directory creation for staging or persistence
PROC:ln: create hard or symbolic links, file system manipulation
PROC:uname: print system information, OS and kernel version discovery
PROC:hostname: show or set system hostname, system identification
PROC:whoami: print current user name, identity verification
PROC:id: print user and group IDs, identity and privilege enumeration
PROC:who: show who is logged in, user session reconnaissance
PROC:env: show or set environment variables, environment inspection
PROC:date: display or set date and time, system time check
PROC:uptime: show system uptime and load, system health reconnaissance
PROC:df: report disk space usage, storage reconnaissance
PROC:du: estimate file space usage, storage analysis
PROC:ls: list directory contents, file system enumeration
PROC:echo: display text, often used in scripts or writing to files
PROC:wc: count lines words and bytes, data measurement
PROC:journalctl: query systemd journal, system log reconnaissance and monitoring
PROC:dmesg: print kernel ring buffer, kernel message reconnaissance
PROC:last: show last logged in users, login history reconnaissance
PROC:grep: search text patterns in files, data search and filtering
PROC:awk: pattern scanning and processing language, data extraction
PROC:sed: stream editor for filtering and transforming text, data modification
PROC:sort: sort lines of text files, data organization
PROC:cut: remove sections from lines, data extraction
PROC:tr: translate or delete characters, data transformation
PROC:readlink: print value of symbolic link, path resolution
PROC:dirname: strip last component from file name, path manipulation
PROC:md5sum: compute MD5 checksums, file integrity verification
PROC:suricata: network IDS IPS engine, intrusion detection monitoring daemon
PROC:snap: snap package manager, containerized application management
PROC:apt: advanced package tool, software package management
PROC:dpkg: debian package manager, package installation and management
PROC:getent: query name service switch, database lookup utility
PROC:modprobe: load or remove kernel modules, kernel extension management
PROC:unix_chkpwd: verify PAM authentication tokens, password checking utility
PROC:python3: Python 3 interpreter, script execution including potential reverse shell or automation
PROC:python: Python interpreter, script execution and automation
PROC:perl: Perl interpreter, text processing and scripting including network operations
PROC:node: Node.js JavaScript runtime, server-side script execution

PROC:dash: Debian almquist shell, lightweight command interpreter
PROC:git: distributed version control system, repository management
PROC:vim: Vi improved text editor, file editing
